mesh.boundary_extraction_source: S1 Text section S1.2: extract volume boundary, separate connected components, merge corresponding endocardia and valve/vein planes.
admission_requirements: all cells linear tetrahedra with valid distinct point indices
positive oriented tetrahedra after explicit recorded orientation canonicalization
nonoverlapping wall domain with manifold connected lumen boundaries
retain source vertex indices for wall-cavity conformity
retain artificial closure faces and tissue interfaces as distinct roles
validate ventricular fibre and sheet basis without silently replacing source values
do not infer absolute physiological cavity volume from unrelated circulation coordinates

article.title: Linking statistical shape models and simulated function in the healthy adult human heart

source_mechanics.evidence_role: published source-model specification, not an executable native material or a subject-specific calibration
source_mechanics.configuration: CT mesh is loaded ventricular end diastole; source cycle first estimated a stress-free unloaded reference configuration; that state is not in the case18 archive

passive_ventricular.law: isochoric Guccione with logarithmic volumetric penalty
passive_ventricular.source: S4 equations 3-7, Table B; same literature-derived values across the cohort

passive_nonventricular.law: isochoric neo-Hookean with quadratic volumetric penalty
passive_nonventricular.source: S4 equation 8 and Table C; average literature values, stiff valve layers are artificial constraints

fibres.sheet_sensitivity: source ventricular law is transversely isotropic; supplied sheets do not establish measured sheet architecture

active_ventricular.calibration: all active values hand-tuned; all nonventricular structures passive
active_ventricular.source: S4 Table D; no silent substitution with prescribed chamber elastance

loading.afterload: separate three-element systemic and pulmonary Windkessel models
loading.valve_resistance_note: S4 prose/table forward values zero for aortic/pulmonary valves were chosen for convergence and healthy-range ejection; large reverse resistances approximate blocked reverse flow. Canonical unit spelling here follows Table F resistance dimensions.
loading.boundary_conditions: omnidirectional springs on selected pulmonary vein/vena cava borders; spatially varying normal epicardial Robin support, maximum near apex and zero near base
loading.source: S4 Tables E-F and final paragraph; main article methods

unresolved_source_inputs: case18 stress-free unloaded nodal configuration is not supplied
density and inertial-mass convention are not specified in the retained main article/S4
numerical Robin spring stiffness values/spatial function are not supplied in S4
main article says superior pulmonary vein anchors while S4 says right pulmonary veins; exact anchors require source resolution
source CARP solver inputs and time-resolved reference trajectory are not in the single-file case18 archive
source forward valve resistance zero is outside the currently shipped strictly positive resistive-edge admission; do not substitute epsilon silently

qualification.measured_anatomy: derived from end-diastolic CT of an asymptomatic participant; no cardiac conditions detected on follow-up after acute chest-pain presentation
constructed_anatomy: atrial thickness2mm,RV thickness3.5mm,aortic thickness2mm,PA thickness3.5mm assigned from literature
left atrial appendage discarded in every case
valve layers constructed by dilation to approximately2mm thickness
blood pools,papillary muscles and trabeculae excluded from tetrahedral wall mesh
vein/valve closure structures support chamber-volume and boundary calculations; they are not functioning measured leaflets
qualification.source_output_evidence: simulation_output.csv reports source simulations, not measured patient pressure-volume calibration; all20 cases shared material/loading parameters; cases09 and10 did not converge
qualification.mass_policy: blood pools excluded; no blood mass may be added/subtracted from mechanical tissue without an explicit wet-mass attribution owner
qualification.circulation_policy: coupling this wall to CVSim21 constitutes a new hybrid model; source Rodero outputs do not validate that hybrid
